ranked_candidates.summary: Bridge research selection directly into the repo-local planning pipeline and validate the planning-to-governance path end to end.
strengths: selected scope can feed the planning pipeline immediately
keeps the bridge local and machine-readable
weaknesses: does not yet integrate the full question/evidence loop
